title: nan
authors: Li Y.; Hu J.; Xu Z.; Lv M.; Zhang J.
key_contribution: Presents a self-calibrated navigation system fusing distance measurements from anchors with visual odometry for GNSS-denied localization, validated on datasets and real-world experiments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Hybrid_Classical_Learning to ensure precise positioning.
